{"consolidated_memory":"## Latency Spikes in ml/serving/batcher.py: Six Distinct Root Causes

Component: ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side)
Test coverage: tests/ml/test_batcher.py
Common repro method: send mixed-size request trace
Common signal: tail far above the median in the serving histogram
Stack: Python

Six separate incidents, each with its own trigger condition and root cause:

**Occasion 1 [2026-01-07]** — PR #1062, branch fix/latency-spike-1
- Trigger: appeared only after client had already retried once
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- Result: throughput rose 61 percent, to 440 requests per second

**Occasion 2 [2026-01-14]** — PR #2306, branch fix/latency-spike-2
- Trigger: only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- Result: reclaimed 19 GB of blob storage

**Occasion 3 [2026-03-22]** — PR #6049, branch fix/latency-spike-3
- Trigger: only after rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- Result: backlog cleared 57 minutes after the deploy

**Occasion 4 [2026-03-29]** — PR #6603, branch fix/latency-spike-4
- Trigger: only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 89 consecutive days

**Occasion 5 [2026-05-25]** — PR #7982, branch fix/latency-spike-5
- Trigger: only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 25 days running

**Occasion 6 [2026-07-24]** — PR #8815, branch fix/latency-spike-6
- Trigger: only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- Result: cold start dropped 24 percent, to 217 ms"}
